name: retrieval-classes
description: Query classes of the knowledge retrieval (SE-R-21, guide §9 version 4): each case is labelled exact, document, recent, complex or concept; `expected` are the items a good ranking puts first. Used by learning.learn_strategies to choose the ranking procedure per class; it is separate from evals/retrieval.json (the S11-R-08 guard) and from benchmarks/retrieval.py (the independent measure). A higher id is newer.
